Paired ears, large dark eyes, light muzzle/chest and two prominent front incisors remain consistent through visible views.
Compact squirrel chest and rounded haunches remain coherent, with the same neutral grounded stance and tail mass through all six rotations.
Grouped sculpted fur and rounded expressive shapes fit Havenline. Tail tips, ears and paws are complete within the panel margins.
